name: Sakura no Mori
source:
Girls school recently started to adopt male students. There's an old urban legend about a ghost called "young lady" at school and three ghost study club members are set to investigate it. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-august-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所女子学校最近开始招收男生。校内流传着一则古老的都市传说，据说有一个名为“大小姐”的幽灵出没。灵异研究社的三名成员决定展开调查。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-august-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
